description: Build a proper spaced repetition scheduler with 'Today's Reviews' dashboard widget, review session interface with recall ratings, and daily review reminder notification
steps: Create src/features/spaced-repetition/ directory: types/, utils/, components/
Create src/features/spaced-repetition/types/index.ts with types: ReviewSession, ScheduledReview, ReviewHistory, DailyStats

Create src/features/spaced-repetition/utils/scheduler.ts that builds on existing SM-2 in src/features/flashcards/utils/sm2.ts - adds scheduling logic: getDueCards(cards, date), getNextReviewDate(card), getDailyReviewCount(), scheduleReview(card, rating)
Create src/features/spaced-repetition/utils/storage.ts for localStorage persistence of review sessions and daily stats (key: 'cfa-buddy-review-sessions')

Create src/features/spaced-repetition/components/todays-reviews-widget.tsx - a dashboard card showing: cards due today count, cards reviewed today, retention rate, next review time. Style with Navy/Gold theme colors

Create src/features/spaced-repetition/components/review-session.tsx - full review session interface: shows card front, user flips to see back, then rates recall with 4 buttons (Again, Hard, Good, Easy). SM-2 updates interval on each rating. Shows progress bar (X of Y reviewed)
Create src/features/spaced-repetition/components/review-complete.tsx - session completion summary: cards reviewed, accuracy, next review schedule
Integrate the TodaysReviewsWidget into the dashboard page: add it to src/features/dashboard/components/dashboard-content.tsx as a new section
Add a route at src/app/(protected)/review/session/page.tsx for the review session interface
Add daily review reminder using the existing notification pattern in src/features/notifications/: create a component that checks if reviews are due and shows an in-app notification banner
Add unit tests in src/features/spaced-repetition/__tests__/scheduler.test.ts testing: getDueCards returns only due cards, scheduling logic with different ratings, daily stats tracking
Run full verification: npm run lint, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, npm run test
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows 'Today's Reviews' widget with due card count
Review session page at /review/session shows flashcards with Again/Hard/Good/Easy buttons
SM-2 algorithm correctly updates card intervals after each rating
Daily reminder notification appears when cards are due
All existing tests still pass plus new scheduler tests
npm run lint and npm run build pass
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run lint
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
